description: This file defines the 'flow' package for managing steps, buttons, and dialogs in a Mattermost plugin, including rendering and processing user interactions.

classes.name: Step
classes.description: Struct representing a step in a flow, including rendering and navigation logic.

classes.name: Button
classes.description: Struct representing an interactive button within a step, including click and dialog submission handlers.

methods.name: NewStep
methods.description: Constructor for creating a new Step with a given name.

methods.name: WithButton
methods.description: Adds buttons to a step.

methods.name: Terminal
methods.description: Marks a step as terminal, preventing further actions.

methods.name: OnRender
methods.description: Sets a custom render function for the step.

methods.name: Next
methods.description: Sets the next step to navigate to after current.

methods.name: WithImage
methods.description: Adds an image URL to the step's message attachment.

methods.name: WithColor
methods.description: Sets the color of the message attachment.

methods.name: WithPretext
methods.description: Adds pretext to the message attachment.

methods.name: WithField
methods.description: Adds a field to the message attachment.

methods.name: WithTitle
methods.description: Sets the title of the message attachment.

methods.name: WithText
methods.description: Sets the main text of the message attachment.

methods.name: do
methods.description: Executes the onRender function and renders the step.

methods.name: done
methods.description: Renders the step as completed, disabling buttons.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Generates the post message for the step, including buttons and actions.

methods.name: processAttachment
methods.description: Processes and formats message attachment with current flow state.

methods.name: processButtons
methods.description: Formats buttons with current state.

methods.name: processDialog
methods.description: Formats dialog elements with current state.

methods.name: renderButton
methods.description: Creates a post action for a button.

methods.name: buttonContext
methods.description: Extracts step name and button index from a button action request.

methods.name: dialogContext
methods.description: Extracts step name and button index from a dialog submission request.
